children: ESTIMATES TTF WINTER 2026-27 STRIP WOULD BE €85/MWH (ABOUT $28/MMBTU) IN CASE OF ESCALATION BUT WITHOUT LIQUEFACTION FACILITIES BEING HIT, AND COULD REACH ABOUT €154/MWH (ABOUT $48/MMBTU) IF FACILITIES WERE HIT
SAYS THIS COMPARES WITH A NO ESCALATION PRICE IN THE €60 TO €70/MWH (ABOUT $20 TO $23/MMBTU) RANGE
